<svg viewBox="0 0 1920 1080" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="1920" height="1080">
  <defs>
    <linearGradient id="curtainL" x1="0%" y1="0%" x2="100%" y2="0%">
      <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#8B0000"/>
      <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#5c0000"/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id="curtainR" x1="0%" y1="0%" x2="100%" y2="0%">
      <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#5c0000"/>
      <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#8B0000"/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id="stageFloor" x1="0%" y1="0%" x2="0%" y2="100%">
      <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#c8960a"/>
      <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#7a5800"/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id="spotlightL" x1="0%" y1="0%" x2="100%" y2="100%">
      <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#fffbe0" stop-opacity="0.22"/>
      <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#fffbe0" stop-opacity="0"/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id="spotlightR" x1="100%" y1="0%" x2="0%" y2="100%">
      <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#fffbe0" stop-opacity="0.22"/>
      <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#fffbe0" stop-opacity="0"/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id="bannerGrad" x1="0%" y1="0%" x2="100%" y2="0%">
      <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#1a0a00"/>
      <stop offset="50%" stop-color="#2a1400"/>
      <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#1a0a00"/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id="goldLine" x1="0%" y1="0%" x2="100%" y2="0%">
      <stop offset="0%" stop-color="transparent"/>
      <stop offset="15%" stop-color="#d4a017"/>
      <stop offset="85%" stop-color="#d4a017"/>
      <stop offset="100%" stop-color="transparent"/>
    </linearGradient>
    <radialGradient id="stageLight" cx="50%" cy="0%" r="70%">
      <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#fff8dc" stop-opacity="0.18"/>
      <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#000000" stop-opacity="0"/>
    </radialGradient>
    <filter id="softshadow">
      <feDropShadow dx="0" dy="4" stdDeviation="10" flood-color="#000000" flood-opacity="0.7"/>
    </filter>
    <filter id="titleshadow">
      <feDropShadow dx="4" dy="4" stdDeviation="8" flood-color="#000000" flood-opacity="0.9"/>
    </filter>
  </defs>

  <!-- Stage background — deep warm black -->
  <rect width="1920" height="1080" fill="#0e0800"/>

  <!-- Stage floor -->
  <polygon points="0,900 1920,900 1920,1080 0,1080" fill="url(#stageFloor)" opacity="0.35"/>

  <!-- Stage light cone from above -->
  <rect width="1920" height="1080" fill="url(#stageLight)"/>

  <!-- Left spotlight beam -->
  <polygon points="200,0 600,0 750,1080 50,1080" fill="url(#spotlightL)" opacity="0.6"/>

  <!-- Right spotlight beam -->
  <polygon points="1720,0 1320,0 1170,1080 1870,1080" fill="url(#spotlightR)" opacity="0.6"/>

  <!-- LEFT CURTAIN -->
  <polygon points="0,0 320,0 260,1080 0,1080" fill="url(#curtainL)"/>
  <!-- curtain folds -->
  <polygon points="60,0 100,0 80,1080 40,1080" fill="#6b0000" opacity="0.5"/>
  <polygon points="150,0 190,0 165,1080 125,1080" fill="#6b0000" opacity="0.4"/>
  <polygon points="230,0 270,0 245,1080 205,1080" fill="#6b0000" opacity="0.35"/>
  <!-- curtain highlight edge -->
  <line x1="320" y1="0" x2="260" y2="1080" stroke="#aa2222" stroke-width="3" opacity="0.7"/>

  <!-- RIGHT CURTAIN -->
  <polygon points="1920,0 1600,0 1660,1080 1920,1080" fill="url(#curtainR)"/>
  <!-- curtain folds -->
  <polygon points="1860,0 1820,0 1840,1080 1880,1080" fill="#6b0000" opacity="0.5"/>
  <polygon points="1770,0 1730,0 1755,1080 1795,1080" fill="#6b0000" opacity="0.4"/>
  <polygon points="1690,0 1650,0 1675,1080 1715,1080" fill="#6b0000" opacity="0.35"/>
  <!-- curtain highlight edge -->
  <line x1="1600" y1="0" x2="1660" y2="1080" stroke="#aa2222" stroke-width="3" opacity="0.7"/>

  <!-- Curtain pelmet / valance top -->
  <rect x="0" y="0" width="1920" height="90" fill="#6b0000"/>
  <rect x="0" y="84" width="1920" height="12" fill="#d4a017"/>
  <!-- valance scallops -->
  <ellipse cx="96" cy="90" rx="96" ry="36" fill="#8B0000"/>
  <ellipse cx="288" cy="90" rx="96" ry="36" fill="#8B0000"/>
  <ellipse cx="480" cy="90" rx="96" ry="36" fill="#8B0000"/>
  <ellipse cx="672" cy="90" rx="96" ry="36" fill="#8B0000"/>
  <ellipse cx="864" cy="90" rx="96" ry="36" fill="#8B0000"/>
  <ellipse cx="1056" cy="90" rx="96" ry="36" fill="#8B0000"/>
  <ellipse cx="1248" cy="90" rx="96" ry="36" fill="#8B0000"/>
  <ellipse cx="1440" cy="90" rx="96" ry="36" fill="#8B0000"/>
  <ellipse cx="1632" cy="90" rx="96" ry="36" fill="#8B0000"/>
  <ellipse cx="1824" cy="90" rx="96" ry="36" fill="#8B0000"/>

  <!-- Main banner background -->
  <rect x="280" y="280" width="1360" height="490" rx="8" fill="url(#bannerGrad)" filter="url(#softshadow)"/>

  <!-- Gold rules -->
  <rect x="280" y="280" width="1360" height="6" fill="url(#goldLine)"/>
  <rect x="280" y="764" width="1360" height="6" fill="url(#goldLine)"/>
  <rect x="280" y="294" width="1360" height="2" fill="url(#goldLine)" opacity="0.4"/>
  <rect x="280" y="756" width="1360" height="2" fill="url(#goldLine)" opacity="0.4"/>

  <!-- Star bursts / decorative dots along gold rule -->
  <circle cx="960" cy="283" r="8" fill="#d4a017"/>
  <circle cx="480" cy="283" r="5" fill="#d4a017" opacity="0.6"/>
  <circle cx="1440" cy="283" r="5" fill="#d4a017" opacity="0.6"/>
  <circle cx="960" cy="767" r="8" fill="#d4a017"/>
  <circle cx="480" cy="767" r="5" fill="#d4a017" opacity="0.6"/>
  <circle cx="1440" cy="767" r="5" fill="#d4a017" opacity="0.6"/>

  <!-- Title line 1 -->
  <text
    x="960"
    y="450"
    text-anchor="middle"
    font-family="'Georgia', 'Times New Roman', serif"
    font-size="112"
    font-weight="bold"
    font-style="italic"
    fill="#f5f0e0"
    filter="url(#titleshadow)"
    letter-spacing="6"
  >You're Not Gonna</text>

  <!-- Title line 2 — big, golden -->
  <text
    x="960"
    y="620"
    text-anchor="middle"
    font-family="'Georgia', 'Times New Roman', serif"
    font-size="140"
    font-weight="bold"
    font-style="italic"
    fill="#f0c040"
    filter="url(#titleshadow)"
    letter-spacing="4"
  >Believe This Shit!</text>

  <!-- Thin rule between title and credit -->
  <rect x="400" y="660" width="1120" height="1" fill="#d4a017" opacity="0.5"/>

  <!-- Credit line -->
  <text
    x="960"
    y="730"
    text-anchor="middle"
    font-family="'Georgia', 'Times New Roman', serif"
    font-size="52"
    font-weight="normal"
    font-style="italic"
    fill="#c8a87a"
    letter-spacing="8"
  >with Neil McManistan, divorced</text>

  <!-- Stage floor reflection line -->
  <line x1="280" y1="900" x2="1640" y2="900" stroke="#d4a017" stroke-width="1" opacity="0.2"/>

  <!-- Footlights glow row -->
  <ellipse cx="400" cy="905" rx="55" ry="14" fill="#fffbe0" opacity="0.18"/>
  <ellipse cx="560" cy="905" rx="55" ry="14" fill="#fffbe0" opacity="0.18"/>
  <ellipse cx="720" cy="905" rx="55" ry="14" fill="#fffbe0" opacity="0.18"/>
  <ellipse cx="880" cy="905" rx="55" ry="14" fill="#fffbe0" opacity="0.18"/>
  <ellipse cx="1040" cy="905" rx="55" ry="14" fill="#fffbe0" opacity="0.18"/>
  <ellipse cx="1200" cy="905" rx="55" ry="14" fill="#fffbe0" opacity="0.18"/>
  <ellipse cx="1360" cy="905" rx="55" ry="14" fill="#fffbe0" opacity="0.18"/>
  <ellipse cx="1520" cy="905" rx="55" ry="14" fill="#fffbe0" opacity="0.18"/>
</svg>
